s: Distraction weakens individuals by diverting them from developing skills and Ikigai. Cultivating focus through deep work, apprenticeships, and reading enables personal growth, agency, and mastery, leading to a more fulfilling life.
sub: The cost of distraction on personal development and Ikigai.
Determinism, complexity, and unpredictability in human behavior.
The role of focus, flow state, and deep work in achieving mastery.
Apprenticeship, specialization, and balanced general education.
Reading as a tool for focus, imagined experience, and civic engagement.
